rules.rule: Review CI and automation workflows for least-privilege permissions, action supply-chain safety, secret exposure risk, concurrency and re-run behavior, and whether jobs can mutate repositories or environments more broadly than intended.

Review shell scripts for quoted variables, empty-variable guards before destructive commands, path safety, idempotency, clear failure modes, and avoiding commands that can recursively delete or overwrite unintended targets.
Review deploy scripts for rollback awareness, explicit environment targeting, secret handling, and safeguards that prevent production-impacting actions from running with ambiguous or missing inputs.
